class.name: OcgGCMakescale
class.brief_description: Implements construction of a scaling transformation in 3D space. The result is a `Geom_Transformation` centered at `Point` with scale factor `Scale`. A MakeScale object provides a framework for: - defining the construction of the transformation, - implementing the construction algorithm, and - consulting the result.
